manaNeeded: {G} if Sunshower Druid is in your hand
easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2 if Sunshower Druid is on top of your library.
description:
Cast Sunshower Druid either from your hand by paying {G} or from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
When Sunshower Druid enters, it triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature and causing you to gain 1 life.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Sunshower Druid, adding {B}.
Activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Sunshower Druid from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.
